mode: read-only static source review; no runtime or network requests

findings.finding: Original bytes verify only their own descriptor SHA/date. No ordinary offer expected original digest, listing/SKU binding or selected monetary/quote field re-extraction is checked. Ordinary parseProduct does not persist originalHtmlSha256 except food source discovery context. Valid replacement bytes at same observation date are not withdrawn by this helper.
findings.regression: Replace a saved price evidence descriptor with another valid retained blob, and substitute a wrong listing/SKU original at same observation time; require rejection. Bind selected monetary/stock/quote context to source extraction or independent source-bound manual review.

findings.finding: Current plan/status performs no invalidation/current-source validity check. A reviewed translation can remain accepted after label/page invalidation while its bytes remain cached.
findings.regression: Approve current source text then invalidate associated evidence/cache/URL, verify current acceptance withdraws with zero provider requests; resolved invalidation/fresh source can recover.

findings.finding: Only html.sha256/imageHash are scanned. Evidence.image and evidence.blob descriptor originals without OCR imageHash are not verified; Happy manually reviewed package images have evidence.image shape.
findings.regression: Attach a legitimate image-only evidence record; remove/corrupt its blob after English review, verify missing-original gap without remotely OCRing under collection stop.

findings.finding: Inventory/manual review original validation rejects every bound invalidation with true invalidated or missing/late invalidatedAt regardless active:false, invalidated:false, or resolvedAt. This disagrees with shared workflowSourceInvalidated semantics.
findings.regression: Resolve or deactivate a previously blocking invalidation using established APIs; reject while active, allow valid originals after resolution. Retain corrupt-source rejection.

findings.finding: Before/after totals must be strictly positive although checkout source parser allows explicit zero totals and full scoped discounts, and unit-rate gates allow nonnegative zero. A fully discounted valid one-line checkout never becomes ready.
findings.regression: Captured merchandise discount equals subtotal and shipping discount equals shipping: positive original sale price, source-verified basket total zero, all correct denominators/rates zero; retain rejection for negative/nonfinite totals.

findings.finding: Readiness does not require affirmative manufacturer chocolate-core identity; generic legacy manufacturer flavour Chocolate plus exact other spec claims can satisfy gates despite absent core proof. New research correctly requires coreFlavour on listing and manufacturer identities.
findings.regression: Legacy exact manufacturer review with generic Chocolate flavour and complete nutrients but no core identity must remain reference-only; exact reviewed chocolate core passes, white/coating-only rejects.

confirmedControls: Actual basket originals require vn/VND source mapping and exact source re-extraction/equality, so the initially suspected foreign-currency replacement cannot occur through real compareBaskets.
Single-line basket merchandise discounts reduce goods subtotal once; shipping discounts determine net freight via after-minus-before; mixed baskets never allocate freight to SKU readiness.
Translation cached review rechecks original text/provider id/version, translated SHA and quality fingerprint; changed text/new partition creates a new plan fingerprint.
Active CAPTCHA stop can coexist with offline cached review/status; this is deliberate and does not itself permit collection or clear stop.
notClaimed: No local/runtime repro was executed in this read-only review
No completeness or purchase readiness claimed
